roundupUrl.label: GitHub Contents API URL for dph-roundup.json

roundupToken.label: Optional read-only GitHub token (leave blank for a public bridge repo)

roundupHmacSecret.label: Optional bridge HMAC secret (must match REDDIT_ROUNDUP_BRIDGE_HMAC_SECRET)

targetSubreddit.label: Subreddit to post to without r/ (blank = this subreddit)

roundupFlairText.label: Post flair text (must match an existing post flair)
